flags.why: The example explains the letter name instead of using it.
flags.fix: Tên em bắt đầu bằng chữ quy. = My name begins with the letter Q.

flags.why: The example explains the digraph's name instead of using it.
flags.fix: Em quên viết chữ quy trong từ “quê”. = I forgot to write the digraph qu in the word “quê”.

flags.why: This meaning denotes a playing-card jack, not a lifting device, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/quy#Vietnamese).
flags.fix: jack (playing card); example: Anh ấy đánh xuống một con quy. = He played a jack.

flags.why: The restricted meaning equated with rũ concerns physical deterioration, not casting off worries, as shown by [the dictionary examples](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/r%E1%BB%A5c).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and its example.

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning of physically touching someone or something.
flags.fix: to touch; to come into physical contact with; example: Đừng động chạm vào người tôi. = Don't touch me.

flags.why: This word belongs to solemn, formal expressions of respect and needs a register warning.

This usage is regional to Central and Southern Vietnamese, documented in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf).
This is a literary term for a ruler and needs a register warning.
